justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/CookieUtil.java, src/test/java/org/jsoup/helper/CookieUtilTest.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/HttpConnection.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/UrlConnectionExecutor.java, and src/main/java11/org/jsoup/helper/HttpClientExecutor.java. CookieUtil is a small 120-line package-private helper with 5 methods (4 static helpers plus 1 private helper) and no instance state; all methods stay within one cohesive responsibility: cookie handling for request headers, response storage, URI conversion, and simple cookie parsing. The tests and call sites show it is a narrowly scoped utility, not a large multi-responsibility class that needs decomposition.
